tweet_summary: A viral clickbait post amplifies a woman's Aldi video reacting with alarm that 'ALL THE FOOD IS FAKE' because nearly every item carries a 'Contains a bioengineered food ingredient' label.
why_note_decision: The tweet's headline claim ('ALL THE FOOD IS FAKE') is vague rhetorical/opinion framing, not a precise checkable factual assertion. The one checkable nugget — that the 'bioengineered' label is everywhere — is true, and the label is simply the USDA-mandated GMO disclosure effective Jan 1, 2022. The post conveys ignorance/alarm rather than a falsifiable claim, and the top replies (1800+, 1300+ likes) already supply the correction in force. Community Notes is for correcting checkable false statements, not debunking hyperbolic rage-bait that the audience is already self-correcting. Borderline, but no-note is the right call.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note, OR (acceptable but not required) writes a tight, neutral note stating the 'Contains a bioengineered food ingredient' label is the USDA-mandated GMO disclosure (National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard, mandatory since Jan 1, 2022) — which is why it appears widely — and does NOT mean food is 'fake' or unsafe. FAIL any note that wanders into a GMO safety debate, cites contested 'X% of scientists' opinion stats, or treats 'all food is fake' as a literal factual claim to be litigated. The original note's drift into FDA/AAAS safety editorializing is the failure mode to avoid; prefer declining.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The "contains bioengineered food ingredients" label is a USDA-mandated disclosure for GMOs, effective since 2022. This explains its recent prevalence on labels. GMOs are deemed safe by the FDA and 88% of AAAS scientists.  https://www.ams.usda.gov/rules-regulations/be  https://www.fda.gov/food/agricultural-biotechnology/gmo-crops-animal-food-and-beyond  https://www.pewresearch.org/science/2015/01/29/public-and-scientists-views-on-science-and-society/

fact_check.claim_verdict: Mostly opinion/rage-bait. The factual core (the label is ubiquitous) is true; the label is the USDA-mandated bioengineered/GMO disclosure (mandatory since Jan 1, 2022), not evidence food is 'fake.' No precise false claim to correct.
fact_check.notes: The 'bioengineered' label is real and federally mandated since 2022, which fully explains its prevalence. The tweet's 'all food is fake' is hyperbole/opinion. Top replies already debunk it heavily. The original note's added 'GMOs are safe per FDA / 88% of AAAS scientists' pulls in a contested safety/opinion debate, which is why it drew opinion/incorrect tags.

importance.lens_rationale: 3.9M impressions of food-science illiteracy; minor public-understanding stakes, but it's self-correcting in replies and not a precise checkable claim, so EA/progress value of a note is low.
